answer: Reviewers stake 50 POA per verdict and a random 10% of verdicts go to a second panel; a wrong verdict burns the stake. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so an old approval cannot be replayed onto new text. No identity reaches the zenith of the payout curve without a clean audit record, and one failed audit clears the grove of stakes gathered over weeks. For a farmer that is 50 POA locked per fake verdict plus a 10% loss chance, paid before any nectar is earned.
